name: Against Lord Shalzaru
summary: Latronicus Moonspear at Feathermoon Stronghold tells you that scouts have identified one of the crueler naga royals, Lord Shalzaru. He asks you to put a stop to Shalzaru and bring back the relic the naga lord uncovered.

sections.title: The Naga Chain of Command
sections.body: New scouting reports have given Latronicus Moonspear a good picture of how the naga are led. Royals sit among their ranks, and it is they who give the orders. One of the crueler of them is Lord Shalzaru.

sections.title: An Odd Relic
sections.body: Scouts report that Shalzaru himself uncovered an odd relic while the naga were digging, in a cave on the Isle of Dread, over the water and south of the main ruins. Latronicus wants an end put to the dig by putting an end to Shalzaru, and wants the Mysterious Relic brought to him at Feathermoon Stronghold so it can be studied.

sections.title: When It Is Done
sections.body: Latronicus believes that Shalzaru's fall will leave the naga in disarray for a while, perhaps for good, and that the threat is now more under control than it has ever been. He then has one more thing to ask of you.

faq.answer: One of the crueler naga royals, identified by scouts. Royals sit among the naga ranks and give the orders.
Scouts place the dig in a cave on the Isle of Dread, over the water and south of the main ruins.
An odd relic that Shalzaru himself uncovered while the naga were digging. Latronicus wants it brought to him so it can be studied.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the relic?
faq.answer: To Latronicus Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.
